title: docs/test.md: say a launch stopped before its run directory leaves no per-run artifact, not 'nothing on disk'
outcome: The interrupted-launch paragraph in docs/test.md describes the pre-run-directory case accurately: no per-run artifact or registration, while a shared review-runs parent may exist.
acceptance: docs/test.md no longer says a launch stopped before its run directory 'leaves nothing on disk'; it says no per-run artifact or registration remains, noting that a first launch in a worktree may already have created the shared review-runs parent (scripts/test-launcher.mjs recursive mkdir).
A two-vendor review of the change has no Medium or higher finding.
